For the Pyzchiva 130 mg vial, the shelf-life is extended from 24 months to 36 months when stored in a refrigerator (2°C-8°C). For the Pyzchiva 45 mg vial, the shelf-life is extended from 36 months to 42 months when stored in a refrigerator (2°C-8°C). Additionally, for both products, the storage condition of the finished drug product (DP) at room temperature is extended to 35 days.
